motion.name: assistant-control-state
motion.purpose: Assistant button fill/border, composer border, and library hover.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Assistant page, panel, and mobile-navigation transitions/animations are removed; global retained motion uses 0.01ms duration and one iteration.

motion.name: fox-form-transition
motion.purpose: Preload the new responsive image before crossfading; failed loads retain the current image, stale callbacks are cancelled, and inactive/static/reduced views do not animate.

motion.name: fox-breathing
motion.purpose: Low-amplitude breathing while visible; disabled in static/reduced modes.

motion.name: fox-greeting
motion.purpose: 650ms greeting on interaction, cleared by a 700ms timer; hidden/offscreen and static/reduced modes stop animation.

motion.name: fox-blink
motion.purpose: Base form only: a clipped generated eye patch appears for about 136ms; inactive/static/reduced or transitioning scenes do not mount the image.

motion.name: fox-pointer-attention
motion.purpose: Lean about ±2.5° within the pointer target, reset on leave; no touch or static/reduced tracking.

motion.name: fox-focus-attention
motion.purpose: Small attentive pose while the input is focused; static/reduced modes remove the pose.

motion.name: appearance-background
motion.purpose: Page and sidebar background changes from the inline five-stop appearance slider; reduced motion removes the transition.

breakpoints.name: mobile-shell

breakpoints.name: compact

breakpoints.name: short-landing

narrative.overview:
Lumen is a calm place to see what is progressing, read a real result, and choose the next action. Pink-snow canvas surrounds white reading surfaces; muted plum identifies the current destination and deliberate primary actions. Bundled Geist, the original Fold L marks and a regenerated transparent nine-tail snow fox give the Web client its identity.

The existing workflows make work legible before adding context. Results, source and version identity, explicit state, and recovery actions carry the meaning. The fox stays a quiet companion whose five forms follow an independent light-background preference. Dense controls use solid surfaces and short transitions.
keyCharacteristics: Pink-snow canvas, white reading surfaces, fine boundaries, and muted plum actions.
One Geist family with Chinese system fallbacks.
Clear work status, real output previews, and one visible next action.
Optional context collapses on narrow screens while results remain visible.
Five regenerated fox forms share one character identity and nine separately visible tail tips.

rules.name: The One Action Accent Rule
rules.body: Use muted plum for deliberate primary actions and current navigation; preserve the fox's authored colors.

rules.name: The State Has Words Rule
rules.body: Color never replaces execution state, source coverage, version identity, or recovery text.

rules.name: The First Viewport Rule
rules.body: On initial entry, show the current work or latest result and its primary action. On narrow feed views, optional context begins collapsed so the first result remains visible.

rules.name: The Quiet Surface Rule
rules.body: Reading surfaces stay flat at rest; hover depth is reserved for library previews and temporary layers.

rules.name: The Appearance Rule
rules.body: Fox growth follows the selected light-background stop, independently of model, thinking strength, Session or task progress.

dos: **Do** preserve the pink-snow palette, Geist, Fold L marks, and the regenerated fox's detail, nine-tail silhouette and transparency.
**Do** put actual progress, a real result, and its primary action in the first viewport.
**Do** keep resource ID and displayed revision together when opening or discussing results.
**Do** use written status, source information, and explicit recovery actions.
**Do** preserve draft/request identity, visible focus, safe-area spacing, bounded scrolling, and motion preferences.
**Do** use real image/text previews with typed fallbacks for stored resources.
donts: **Don't** import the root Architecture Atlas theme into this app.
**Don't** use decorative faint gray for body text or a meaning-bearing icon.
**Don't** expand optional mobile context so it displaces the first result.
**Don't** add a separate Memory navigation entry or encode state only with color.
**Don't** replace the corner L marks with the companion, restore archived renderers, or infer model load from fox forms.
**Don't** treat a prepared result, screenshot, or companion expression as proof of delivery or execution.
